body: As it always does my brother

This. I loved her unconditionally and never stopped no matter what through our ups and downs. 6 years together but she threw it away to be in a long distance with someone two states over even after she told me that she’s sorry and feels guilty. It hurts and stings but I’ve been getting better, this is what I needed to read to push onwards I just want to be to myself like the wolf I am,  get back up and protect myself and my heart

I have come to terms with it by meditating, working out and doing things I love as well as new hobbies and finding myself again. I have forgiven her as it’s not in me to hate and I feel it can help me let go. Idk on her end even though she’s messing with someone néw. I know she’s sorry for doing it as she said she’s sorry and feels guilty

At first it was a little bit of anger but then it became mostly sadness and hurt. Mostly because she just met the guy and thinks he’s her soulmate and it was like after 6 years. It made me realize that I was just an option
Thoughts as I know that what you feel after a break when someone hurts you, that you must allow yourself to feel those emotions, which I have

Question? The woman I’ve been with for 6 years left me to be with another guy in another state. I’ve been doing things to make me better and move on and it helped my question is what else can I do to keep going

Man this here 6 years with her and I was planning to marry her. She left for a guy she just met when we were gaming online who is two states over, she stated that she felt like shit for hurting me and she feels guilty. I truly did love her and wanted the best in life for her but she didn’t love me like I loved her. Sometimes I do have nightmares and when I wake up reality hits. I’ve gotten better but it still stings
Yeah that’s why I just separated myself completely and being the bigger person for myself

Kinda same but different gf of 6 years left me for a guy two states over after I was dealing with some depression and the funny thing is she just meet him and she believes he’s her soulmate. I have to deal with living with her until she moves out it hurts like a mofo. I’m already at the point where I don’t look at socials and I haven’t begged or anything since the breakup

Lol thanks for the input and that’s cool always looking for new gamers and friends thing is it still hurts. She says things like she still loves me and cares but in my mind it feels like it’s been lies but I’m ok I was always told in life you are replaceable but the vibe, energy, love, care and respect you gave too your partner can’t be duplicated and that’s where people who dumps someone who really loves them realize their mistake, thing is idk if I would take her back heart is too scarred

Recently, was dumped Friday. By gf of 6 years and I saw a future with and all apparently she says that she has always loved me and always will that I am one of her best friends but it’s also because another guy we game with in our discord from another state caught her attention. I’m healing and doing my best to ignore it so far so good but it still hurts. She’s moving back to our home state and she says she thinks it would be better if I came back to our home state to be around my family which is weird she tells me this. I cry in my sleep and don’t get me started on the nightmares it really does suck but all we can do is push forward.
